Function reference

Read

Read detections, receiver deployments, animal records and tag specification sheets from OTN, GLATOS and InnovaSea files, and join them into one detection set.

read_detections()
Read detections from an OTN, GLATOS, InnovaSea or detqc file
read_deployments()
Read receiver deployments from an OTN, GLATOS or detqc sheet
read_animals()
Read animal and tag records from an OTN, GLATOS or detqc sheet
read_tag_specs()
Read a tag specification sheet
read_receiver_logs()
Read the status records of receiver logs
column_map()
Column maps for the import functions
calibrate_sensors()
Convert raw sensor readings to physical values
detset()
Build a detection set
read_detset_from()
Build a detset from glatos detections or an actel preload

Check and summarise

Find data-entry errors, record which receivers listened, and look at the detections before you remove any.

check_detset()
Check detections, deployments and animals for data-entry errors
all_checks()
The data-entry and deployment checks
check_settings()
Thresholds of the data-entry checks
validate_detset()
Check a detection set
audit_listening()
Audit which receivers listened on which days
detset_log()
The processing log of a detection set
summarise_detections()
Summarise detections by animal, station, receiver or day
summarise_animals()
Summarise animals, detected or not
residency_index()
Residency index of each animal, at each station or in the array

Filter

Each filter is opt-in and writes one line to the processing log.

filter_duplicates()
Remove duplicated detections
filter_release()
Remove detections before release
filter_post_release()
Remove detections in a window after release
filter_deployment_period()
Keep the detections inside a deployment of their receiver
filter_tag_life()
Remove detections after the tag's expected life
filter_min_lag()
Remove detections isolated in time
minimum_lags()
The minimum lag of every detection
filter_min_detections()
Remove the detections of animals with too few detections
filter_speed()
Remove detections that imply an impossible speed
speed_steps()
The steps the speed filter tests
filter_animals()
Keep the detections of some animals or species

Review mortality

The rules sort animals into dead, review and alive bands. You make each call on a review card, and the calls come back to the set.

detect_mortality()
Sort animals into dead, review and alive bands
mortality_rules()
The rule streams of the mortality triage
mortality_rule()
Define a mortality rule stream
review_mortality()
Open the mortality review in a browser
build_mortality_cards()
Write the mortality review cards and their index
apply_mortality_calls()
Bring the reviewer's calls back onto a detection set
reconcile_mortality()
Find the calls that new data or new bands put in question
filter_mortality()
Remove detections after each death date

Export

Hand the set to detfield, glatos, actel or the ATO tables, save it with its log, and write the processing report. read_detset() is documented with write_detset().

as_detfield_input()
The tables detfield::bin_detections() takes
to_glatos()
Convert a detset to glatos detections
to_actel()
Convert a detset to the four tables of actel::preload()
to_ato()
Convert a detset to the tables of the trackyverse ATO
write_detset() read_detset()
Save a detset to disc, and read it back
processing_report()
Write the processing report of a detection set

Plot

The figures of a detection set, and the theme, depth scale, probability scale and scale bar positionR maps are drawn with.

plot_receivers()
Map of the receiver stations
plot_abacus()
Abacus plot of detections by animal over time
plot_timeline()
Deployment timeline by station
plot_attrition()
Draw the detections left after each logged step
theme_positionr()
The positionR figure theme
positionr_ring_colours()
Receiver ring colours of the positionR maps
scale_fill_depth()
Depth scale for a map
scale_fill_probability()
Probability scale for a map
annotation_scale_bar()
Scale bar for a map

Example data

The Stoney Lake study as read, prepared for the mortality rules with the true fate of each animal, and read, checked and filtered. Its files are in system.file("extdata", package = "detqc").

detqc_example
The Stoney Lake example study, as read
example_mortality
The Stoney Lake example study, prepared for the mortality rules
stoney_clean
The Stoney Lake example study, read, checked and filtered
